{{Quote|Power up the guns; everyone take defensive positions.|The resistance fighter|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
A '''resistance fighter''' was stationed at a [[Naboo resistance base]] during the course of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
When the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] became involved in a desperate battle for the defense of their [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. This [[Naboo Resistance|resistance]] fighter joined in the fight. When Naboo's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] returned to the planet after her exile, she rounded up all the surviving [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to plan the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|end of the war]]. The [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] would draw out the main part of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] while the Queen led a ground assault of the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to capture the [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]]. This resistance fighter was stationed at a [[Naboo resistance base|resistance outpost]] on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]]. The Trade Federation sent the Army B to flank the Plains and attack the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> but the [[Army/Legends|army]] engaged the outpost instead. The resistance fighter ordered her outpost to get ready to fight. Two [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] allies of the Security Forces, [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and [[Vana Sage]] were on hand to protect the outpost. The resistance fighter kept up a running commentary while the two spacers engaged Army B. The base was being overrun when [[Rhys Dallows|two]] [[Reti|more]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] showed up to protect the base. The combined firepower drove off the attacking vehicles and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The resistance fighter then thanked the pilots as they flew off.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
This resistance fighter appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']].
